articles.title: An Astronaut Spots 'Moon Rock' on Earth
articles.summary: An astronaut on the space station photographed a bright patch in Madagascar made of the same kind of rock found on the Moon.

articles.title: Ancient Glue May Have Helped Neanderthals Fight Germs
articles.summary: Scientists made birch tar the way Neanderthals did and found it stopped germs that can infect cuts.

articles.title: How Colors and Gases Could Help Us Find Tiny Aliens
articles.summary: Scientists are studying tough germs on Earth to learn how to spot tiny life on Venus, Mars and faraway planets.
